title: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly
english: The G7 nations have issued a joint statement demanding that Iran cease its military support for Houthi rebels in Yemen. They condemned the recent increase in Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and civilian shipping, warning that these actions threaten global energy security and economic stability. The group called for an immediate halt to the fighting and urged all parties to engage in a peaceful political process to resolve the conflict.
amharic: የጂ7 አገራት ኢራን በየመን ለሚገኙት የሁቲ አማፂያን የምታደርገውን ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ በአስቸኳይ እንድታቆም በጋራ ባወጡት መግለጫ አሳስበዋል። ቡድኑ በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በንግድ መርከቦች ላይ የሚያደርሰውን ጥቃት በማውገዝ፣ ይህ ድርጊት ለአለም አቀፍ የኢነርጂ ደህንነት እና ለኢኮኖሚ መረጋጋት ስጋት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የጂ7 አገራት በግጭቱ የተሳተፉ ወገኖች ሁሉ ጥቃቱን አቁመው ወደ ሰላማዊ የፖለቲካ ድርድር እንዲመለሱ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Biyyoonni garee G7, Iran deeggarsa waraanaa garee Hutiif Yemen keessatti gootu hatattamaan akka dhaabdu gaafataniiru. Gareen kun saudi Arabiyaa fi dooniiwwan daldalaa irratti haleellaa geggeessuun isaa nageenya anniisaa fi tasgabbii dinagdee addunyaa irratti balaa akka qabu ibsaniiru. Biyyoonni kun gareen Huti haleellaa isaa dhaabee, rakkoo biyyattii marii nagaan furuuf akka itti deebi'u dhaamaniiru.

title: ‘Orphaned’ by floods, more than 500 Nepali children face uncertain future
english: More than 500 children in Nepal are currently living in temporary shelters after losing their parents in the devastating floods that occurred on August 26. While many of these children are effectively orphaned, legal complexities regarding the declaration of death for missing persons have left them in a state of uncertainty. These youngsters now face a difficult future as they wait for news about their families while living in government-provided facilities.
amharic: በኔፓል ነሐሴ 26 ቀን በደረሰው አውዳሚ ጎርፍ ወላጆቻቸውን ያጡ ከ500 በላይ ህጻናት ጊዜያዊ መጠለያ ጣቢያዎች ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ ህጻናት ወላጅ አልባ ቢሆኑም፣ የጠፉ ሰዎች ህጋዊ የሞት ማረጋገጫ ለማግኘት ያለው ውስብስብ ሂደት ለወደፊታቸው ትልቅ እርግጠኛ አለመሆንን ፈጥሮባቸዋል። ህጻናቱ ስለ ቤተሰቦቻቸው መረጃ ለማግኘት በመጠባበቅ ላይ እያሉ አስቸጋሪ ጊዜን እያሳለፉ ነው።
oromo: Neepaal keessatti, lolaa Hagayya 26 ga'een booda ijoolleen 500 ol ta'an warra isaanii dhabanii bakka qubannaa yeroo keessa jiraachaa jiru. Ijoolleen kun hundi maatii isaanii dhabanis, seera biyyattii keessatti namni bade tokko du'e jedhamee labsamuuf adeemsa walxaxaa waan qabuuf, ijoolleen kun haala gaaffii keessa galche keessa jiru. Ijoolleen kun maatii isaanii ilaalchisee oduu dhaga'uuf eegaa, haala jireenyaa rakkisaa keessatti argamu.

title: G7 foreign ministers demand Houthis halt strikes on Saudi Arabia
english: Foreign ministers from the G7 nations have strongly condemned the ongoing Houthi military attacks against Saudi Arabia and international shipping. The group urged the Houthis to end these hostilities and return to diplomatic negotiations. Furthermore, the ministers accused Iran of fueling regional instability by supplying weapons to the Houthis in violation of UN resolutions.
amharic: የሰባት ሀገራት ቡድን (G7) የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በንግድ መርከቦች ላይ የሚያደርሱትን ጥቃት በፅኑ አውግዘዋል። ሚኒስትሮቹ ታጣቂዎቹ ጥቃቱን እንዲያቆሙ እና ወደ ሰላማዊ ድርድር እንዲመለሱ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። በተጨማሪም ኢራን የዩኤን ደንቦችን በመተላለፍ ለሁቲዎች የጦር መሳሪያ በማቅረብ በአካባቢው አለመረጋጋትን እየፈጠረች መሆኑን ከሰዋል።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa biyyoota gurguddoo torba (G7) gareen Hutiin Saudii Arabiyaa fi dooniiwwan daldalaa irratti raawwachaa jiran balaaleffataniiru. Gareen kunneen sochiin waraanaa kun akka dhaabbatuu fi gara marii nagaatti akka deebi'an gaafataniiru. Kana malees, Iraan seera dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomanii cabsuun meeshaa waraanaa Hutiif dhiyeessuun nagaa naannichaa booressaa akka jirtu himataniiru.

title: UN General Assembly 2026: When is it, who is speaking and when?
english: The 2026 United Nations General Assembly high-level debate begins on September 22 in New York, featuring addresses from nearly 130 world leaders. The session, chaired by President Khalilur Rahman, runs through late September with daily speeches scheduled from morning until night. Following tradition, Brazil will open the event, followed by the United States, as representatives discuss global issues at the UN headquarters.
amharic: የ2026 የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ክርክር መስከረም 12 ቀን በኒውዮርክ የሚጀመር ሲሆን ወደ 130 የሚጠጉ የሀገር መሪዎች ይሳተፉበታል። ጉባኤው በፕሬዝዳንት ካሊሉር ራህማን የሚመራ ሲሆን፣ ንግግሮች ከጠዋት እስከ ማታ በየቀኑ ይካሄዳሉ። እንደ ባህሉ ብራዚል መድረኩን የምትከፍት ሲሆን፣ በመቀጠልም አሜሪካ ንግግሯን ታደርጋለች።
oromo: Waltajjiin walii-galaa Mootummoota Gamtoomanii bara 2026 Sadaasa 22 Niyoorkitti kan jalqabu yoo ta'u, hogganootni biyyoota 130 ta'an irratti hirmaatu. Waltajjiin kun pirezidaantii Khaliiluur Raahmaanitiin kan durfamu yoo ta'u, haasaan guyyaa guutuu ganama hanga galgalaatti gaggeeffama. Aadaa durii hordofee biyyi Braaziil haasaa jalqabaa kan gootu yoo ta'u, ittaansuun Ameerikaanis haasaa ishee ni dhiyeessi.

title: Why does the US want to send Israel 40,000 bombs?
english: The United States is currently considering a $2.8 billion arms deal that includes the shipment of 40,000 bombs to Israel. Experts are debating whether this significant transfer of weapons is a necessary security measure or if it risks intensifying civilian harm in Gaza. The discussion highlights concerns regarding the proportionality of this military support in the context of the ongoing conflict.
amharic: አሜሪካ እስራኤልን በ2.8 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ዋጋ ያላቸው 40,000 ቦምቦች ለመርዳት እቅድ አላት። ባለሙያዎች ይህ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው የጦር መሳሪያ ድጋፍ አስፈላጊ መከላከያ ነው ወይስ በጋዛ የሲቪል ህዝብ ላይ ጉዳት ያደርሳል በሚለው ጉዳይ ላይ ውይይት እያደረጉ ነው። ጉዳዩ በግጭቱ ወቅት የሚደረገው የወታደራዊ ድጋፍ መጠን ተገቢነት ላይ ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Ameerikaan meeshaa waraanaa kan gatiin isaa biliyoona 2.8 ga'u fi boombii 40,000 ta'u Israa'eliif dhiyeessuuf karoorfateetti. Ogeeyyonni dhimma kana irratti mari'ataa jiran yoo ta'u, gargaarsi kun nageenyaaf barbaachisaa dha moo balaa lammilee Gaaza keessa jiran irratti gahuu danda'a kan jedhu irratti falmiin jira. Dhimmi kun gargaarsi waraanaa yeroo ammaa taasifamaa jiru madaalawaa ta'uu fi dhiisuu isaa irratti shakkii uumee jira.

title: Houthis battle for strategic heights in Yemen as thousands more flee homes
english: Fighting has intensified in Yemen as Houthi rebels attempt to capture key mountains overlooking the Red Sea to cut off government supply lines. The conflict has already resulted in hundreds of deaths and displaced over 150,000 civilians from their homes. Reports indicate that the United States nearly launched airstrikes against the rebels at Saudi Arabia's request but ultimately cancelled the operation at the last moment.
amharic: የሁቲ አማፂያን በየመን ቀይ ባህር አቅራቢያ የሚገኙ ስልታዊ ተራሮችን ለመቆጣጠር በሚያደርጉት ከፍተኛ ጦርነት ምክንያት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ከቤት ንብረታቸው ተፈናቅለዋል። ግጭቱ እስካሁን ከ670 በላይ ሰዎችን ሲገድል ከ158 ሺህ በላይ ነዋሪዎችንም ለስደት ዳርጓል። ዘገባዎች እንደሚያመለክቱት የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በሳውዲ አረቢያ ጥያቄ መሰረት በሁቲዎች ላይ የአየር ጥቃት ሊሰነዝሩ ተዘጋጅተው የነበረ ቢሆንም በመጨረሻው ሰዓት ሰርዘውታል።
oromo: Houthiwwan humnoota mootummaa wajjin ta’uun tulluuwwan murteessoo galaana diimaa to’achuuf wal lolaa jiru, kunis namoota hedduu manaa isaanii akka baqatan taasiseera. Lolli kun hanga ammaatti namoota 670 ol kan ajjeese yoo ta’u, namoota 158,000 ol ammoo qe’ee isaanii irraa buqqiseera. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp gaaffii Sa’udii Arabiyaatiin tarkaanfii qilleensaa fudhachuuf qophaa’anii kan turan ta’us, daqiiqaa dhumaa irratti ajajicha haqaniiru.

title: Saudi air strike targets a local market in a village near Bab al-Mandeb in Yemen
english: Houthi forces in Yemen have shared video evidence alleging that a Saudi-led airstrike hit a marketplace near the Bab al-Mandeb Strait. This area is currently under Houthi control after they successfully pushed out forces supported by the Saudi government. The incident highlights the ongoing conflict over this vital coastal region.
amharic: የየመኑ ሁቲ አማፂያን የሳውዲ ጥምረት በባብ አል-ማንደብ ባህር ዳርቻ በሚገኝ ገበያ ላይ የአየር ድብደባ ማድረሱን የሚያሳይ ምስል ይፋ አድርገዋል። ሁቲዎች ይህንን ስትራቴጂያዊ ቦታ ከሳውዲ መንግስት ድጋፍ ከሚያገኙ ሃይሎች በመውሰድ በቁጥጥራቸው ስር አድርገውታል። ይህ ክስተት በስልታዊ ጠቀሜታ ባለው የባህር ዳርቻ አካባቢ የሚካሄደውን ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Humni Huutii kan Yemen, xiyyarri waraana Saudii gabaa ganda Bab al-Mandab biratti argamu irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaa viidiyoon ragaa ta'u ibsaniiru. Bakki kun kan to'atame, humni Huutii humnoota mootummaa Saudiin gargaaraman erga ari'anii booda. Haleellaan kun naannoo qarqara galaanaa kan hidhannoo cimaa qabu kana irratti waldhabdee jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: UK's Burnham agrees to Saudi request for refuelling support
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has authorized the provision of temporary air-to-air refueling support to Saudi Arabia for defensive purposes. This decision comes in response to increased Houthi attacks on the country during the ongoing regional conflict. The Prime Minister stated that this assistance is intended to help maintain stability in the area and keep essential trade routes open.
amharic: የብሪታንያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ለሳዑዲ አረቢያ ለራስ መከላከያ የሚውል የአየር ላይ ነዳጅ ማደያ ድጋፍ በጊዜያዊነት ለመስጠት ተስማምተዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰደው በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ባለው ግጭት በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳዑዲ ላይ ጥቃት መጨመሩን ተከትሎ ነው። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ይህ ድጋፍ የክልሉን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ እና አስፈላጊ የንግድ መስመሮችን ክፍት ለማድረግ ያለመ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Biriitaaniyaa Andy Burnham Saudii Arabiyaaf deeggarsa boba'aa qilleensa irraa yeroo gabaabaaf ta'u kan kennan ta'uu ibsaniiru. Murteen kun kan dhufte erga haleellaan garee Huutii biyyattii irratti hammaatee booda dha. Muummeen Ministirichaa akka ibsanitti, gargaarsi kun tasgabbii naannichaa eeguuf fi daandiiwwan daldalaa barbaachisoo ta'an bananii tursiisuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Vermont man found guilty of shooting three Palestinian students in 2023
english: A Vermont jury has convicted Jason Eaton of three counts of attempted murder for shooting three Palestinian college students in 2023. Eaton attacked the victims while they were walking to a family dinner, causing life-altering injuries including permanent paralysis for one student. Although his defense claimed he was experiencing delusions during the incident, the court ultimately found him guilty of the charges.
amharic: የቨርሞንት ፍርድ ቤት ጄሰን ኢቶን የተባሉ ግለሰብ በ2023 ሶስት ፍልስጤማውያን የዩኒቨርሲቲ ተማሪዎችን በመተኮስ ለሞት የሚዳርግ ጉዳት በማድረሳቸው ጥፋተኛ መሆናቸውን አረጋግጧል። ተጠርጣሪው ተማሪዎቹን ያጠቃቸው ወደ እራት ግብዣ በሚሄዱበት ወቅት ሲሆን፣ ጥቃቱ በአንዱ ተማሪ ላይ ዘላቂ የአካል ጉዳት አስከትሏል። የመከላከያ ጠበቆች ተጠርጣሪው የአእምሮ ችግር እንደነበረበት ቢከራከሩም፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ግን በቀረበበት ክስ ጥፋተኛ ብሎታል።
oromo: Mana murtii Vermontitti, Jason Eaton namni jedhamu tokko bara 2023 barattoota Falasxiin sadii irratti dhukaasa banuun yakka ajjeechaa yaaluun himatamee argameera. Namni kun barattoota gara mana nyaataatti deemutti jiran irratti miidhaa cimaa kan geessise yoo ta'u, barattoota keessaa tokko qaama isaa guutummaatti dhaquun miidhamuun isaa gabaafameera. Abbootiin seeraa himatamaa kanaan dura yaada fayyaa sammuu dhabuu akka qabu falmatanis, dhuma irratti garuu yakka isaa irratti hundaa'uun murtoo badii irratti dabarsaniiru.

title: Vermont man found guilty of shooting three Palestinian students in 2023
english: A Vermont jury has convicted Jason Eaton of three counts of attempted second-degree murder for shooting three Palestinian college students in 2023. Although Eaton's defense team claimed he was suffering from delusions, he was found legally responsible for the attack which left one victim paralyzed. The victims' families expressed disappointment that the incident was not officially classified as a hate crime, despite their firm belief that the students were targeted for their identity.
amharic: የቨርሞንቱ ነዋሪ ጄሰን ኤተን እ.ኤ.አ በ2023 ሶስት ፍልስጤማዊ ተማሪዎችን በጥይት በመተኮሱ ጥፋተኛ ሆኖ ተገኝቷል። ተከሳሹ በወቅቱ የአዕምሮ ህመም እንዳለበት ቢከራከርም፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ግን ለድርጊቱ ሙሉ ሃላፊነት እንዳለበት ወስኗል። የተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች ጥቃቱ በዘር ጥላቻ የተፈጸመ መሆኑን ቢገልጹም፣ ህጉ ይህን ግምት ውስጥ ባለማስገባቱ ቅሬታቸውን አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Namni Vermont jiraatu Jason Eaton jedhamu, bara 2023 barattoota Falasxiin sadii irratti dhukaasa banuun isaa mirkanaa'eera. Gareen himatamaa inni yeroo sanatti rakkoo sammuu akka qabu himatanis, mana murtiitti garuu gocha kanaaf itti gaafatamaa ta'uun isaa murtaa'eera. Maatiin midhamtootaa, gochi kun jibbaa fi garaagarummaa irratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu isaa dubbatanis, seerichi akka yakka jibbaatti waan hin lakkoofneef komii qaban ibsataniiru.

title: Turkish Airlines, Pegasus and AJet cancel Iran flights as US sanctions bite
english: Major Turkish airlines including Turkish Airlines, Pegasus, and AJet have suspended all flights to and from Iran due to new, strict US sanctions. These sanctions affect both Boeing and Airbus aircraft because they contain US-made parts, making it impossible for the carriers to continue their operations. Furthermore, Turkey has begun taking significant financial actions against Iranian-linked banks, reflecting a shift in how the country is managing its economic ties with Tehran.
amharic: የቱርክ አየር መንገድን፣ ፔጋሰስን እና ኤጄትን ጨምሮ ዋና ዋና የቱርክ አየር መንገዶች በአሜሪካ አዲሱ ማዕቀብ ምክንያት ወደ ኢራን የሚያደርጉትን በረራ በሙሉ አቁመዋል። ማዕቀቡ ቦይንግ እና ኤርባስ አውሮፕላኖች የአሜሪካ ክፍሎችን ስለሚጠቀሙ አየር መንገዶቹ በረራቸውን ለመቀጠል እንዳይችሉ አድርጓቸዋል። ከዚህም በላይ ቱርክ ከኢራን ጋር ያላትን የኢኮኖሚ ግንኙነት በመገምገም ከኢራን ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸውን ባንኮች ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃ መውሰድ ጀምራለች።
oromo: Xiyyaarri Turkii kanneen akka Turkish Airlines, Pegasus fi AJet, sababa qulqullina maallaqaa fi sanada Ameerikaa irraa dhufteen gara Iraanitti balali'uusaanii dhaabaniiru. Sanadni kun xiyyaarota Boeing fi Airbus hunda kan dabalatu ta'ee, xiyyaarotni kunneen kutaalee Ameerikaa keessatti oomishaman waan qabaniif hojiin balaliisaa itti fufuu hin danda'u. Kana malees, Turkii hariiroo isheen Iraan wajjin qabdu ilaalchisee tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachaa jirti, keessattuu baankota Iraan wajjin walqabatan irratti dhiibbaa taasisuu eegalteetti.

title: Here’s what to pay attention to at the UNGA
english: Global leaders have gathered in New York for the 81st session of the UN General Assembly amidst growing international conflict. A major focus of the meeting is the weakening trust in global institutions as powerful nations increasingly disregard international laws. The assembly serves as a critical test to see if established global rules can still effectively govern current world crises.
amharic: የዓለም መሪዎች በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እየተባባሱ በመጡ ግጭቶች እና ዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት ላይ ያለው እምነት እየቀነሰ በመምጣቱ 81ኛው የተባበሩት መንግሥታት ድርጅት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ ለመሳተፍ ኒውዮርክ ተሰብስበዋል። ጉባኤው ትኩረት የሚያደርገው ሀያል አገራት ዓለም አቀፍ ደንቦችን ችላ በሚሉበት ወቅት እነዚህ ደንቦች አሁንም ተፈጻሚነት ሊኖራቸው ይችል እንደሆነ ነው። ይህ ስብሰባ አሁን ላለው ዓለም አቀፍ ቀውስ መፍትሄ በመፈለግ በኩል ወሳኝ ፈተና እንደሚሆን ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni addunyaa walitti bu'iinsa idil-addunyaa dabalaa jiruufi amantaan dhaabbilee idil-addunyaa irratti qaban hir'achaa dhufuun wal-qabatee, gubii 81ffaa Walgahii Waliigalaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii irratti hirmaachuuf Niiw Yoorkitti walga'aniiru. Walgahichi kan xiyyeeffatu, biyyoonni gurguddaan seera idil-addunyaa cabsaa yeroo jiranitti, seeronni kunneen ammas bu'aa qabaachuu danda'u moo hin danda'an kan jedhu irrattiidha. Walgahichi rakkoolee addunyaa amma mudataa jiran hiikuuf qormaata guddaa ta'a jedhamee eegama.

title: Trump returns to the UN, what will he say?
english: Donald Trump is returning to the United Nations General Assembly following a year marked by escalating international tensions. His visit comes as he faces scrutiny over his role in the current conflict with Iran and ongoing issues regarding ceasefire violations in Gaza. Observers are now waiting to hear his message and understand the specific goals the United States intends to pursue through the UN.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ ለመገኘት ወደ ኒውዮርክ ተመልሰዋል። ጉብኝታቸው የተካሄደው ከኢራን ጋር በተፈጠረው ግጭት እና በጋዛ የተኩስ አቁም ጥሰቶች ውስጥ ስላላቸው ሚና ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበ ባለበት ወቅት ነው። አለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ የአሜሪካን ቀጣይ አላማ እና ትራምፕ በጉባኤው ላይ የሚያቀርቡትን ንግግር በጉጉት እየጠበቀ ይገኛል።
oromo: Donald Tiraamp waggaa tokko booda gara gamtaa mootummoota gamtoomaniitti deebi'uun qophiirra jiru. Deebiin isaa kun waraana Iraan waliin jiruufi dhaabbata waraanaa Gaazaarratti raawwatamee jiru keessatti gahee qaban irratti qeeqa guddaa waliin walqabata. Addunyaan hundi ammaa kun ergaa isaanii fi kaayyoo Ameerikaan Gamtaa Mootummoota Gamtoomaniin fayyadamuun galmaan gahuu barbaaddu beekuuf eegaa jiru.

title: UK to refuel Saudi jets to help counter Houthi attacks
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has announced that the UK will provide air-to-air refueling support for Saudi Arabian aircraft to help them defend against recent Houthi missile and drone attacks. This time-limited mission is intended to protect regional stability and ensure the security of critical oil shipping routes. British officials emphasized that this support is strictly defensive and will not involve participating in offensive operations against Houthi forces.
amharic: የብሪታኒያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም የሳውዲ አረቢያን የአየር ኃይል በሁቲዎች ከሚሰነዘርባቸው ሚሳኤል እና ድሮን ጥቃት ለመከላከል እንዲረዳ የነዳጅ ማደያ ድጋፍ እንደሚሰጡ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሱን ጊዜ ያለው ተልዕኮ የአካባቢውን ሰላም ለመጠበቅ እና ወሳኝ የሆኑ የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መስመሮችን ደህንነት ለማረጋገጥ ያለመ ነው። የብሪታኒያ ባለስልጣናት ይህ ድጋፍ ለመከላከያ ዓላማ ብቻ የተገደበ እንጂ በሁቲ ኃይሎች ላይ ለሚወሰዱ ጥቃቶች እንደማይውል አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Muummee ministiraa biyyattii Andy Burnham, mootummaan UK xiyyara waraana Saudii kanneen haleellaa duulaa fi mishaayilaa Houtootaa irraa of ittisuuf yaalan gargaaruuf, qilleensa irratti boba'aa akka naquuf murteessuufi ibsaniiru. Gargaarsi kun nageenya naannichaa fi karaa boba'aan ittiin darbu eeguuf kan yaadame yoo ta'u, yeroo murtaa'eef qofa kan turudha. Qondaaltonni UK akka ibsanitti, gargaarsi kun haleellaa of ittisuuf qofa kan oolu malee, loltoota Houtii irratti duuluuf kan gargaaru miti.

title: Typhoon Dujuan kills two in Japan, causes travel chaos near Tokyo
english: Typhoon Dujuan recently struck Japan, resulting in two fatalities and widespread disruption near Tokyo. The powerful storm caused significant flooding, landslides, and power outages, forcing over 1.6 million people to evacuate their homes. Furthermore, the typhoon led to the cancellation of numerous flights and train services, while several major public events were called off due to safety concerns.
amharic: ዱጁዋን የተሰኘው ኃይለኛ አውሎ ንፋስ በጃፓን በመከሰቱ ሁለት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ በቶኪዮ አካባቢም ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እና መስተጓጎል አስከትሏል። አውሎ ንፋሱ ያስከተለው የጎርፍ መጥለቅለቅ እና የመሬት መንሸራተት ከ1.6 ሚሊዮን በላይ የሚሆኑ ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲለቀቁ አስገድዷል። በዚሁ ምክንያት በረራዎች እና የባቡር አገልግሎቶች የተሰረዙ ሲሆን፣ በርካታ ህዝባዊ ዝግጅቶችም ተቋርጠዋል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin Dujuan jedhamu tokko Jappaan keessatti mudachuun lubbuun namoota lamaa akka darbu taasiseera, akkasumas naannoo Tookiyootti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Obomboleettiin cimaan kun lolaa fi lafti akka naanna'u waan taasiseef, namoonni miiliyoona 1.6 ol ta'an manneen isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Kanaan walqabatee, balalliiwwanii fi tajaajilli baaburaa addaan kan cite yoo ta'u, qophiin gurguddaanis nageenyaaf jecha haqamaniiru.

title: Morocco’s youth take Gen Z protest demands to the polls
english: Young candidates in Morocco are running for parliamentary seats following widespread protests led by Gen Z over poor public services, unemployment, and corruption. While these activists are trying to turn recent social unrest into formal political change, youth participation remains low compared to older voters. The upcoming election serves as a critical test of whether the younger generation can successfully transition from street activism to the legislative process.
amharic: በሞሮኮ የዘንድሮውን የፓርላማ ምርጫ ተከትሎ፣ ወጣት እጩዎች ቀደም ሲል በነበሩት የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ያነሱትን የመልካም አስተዳደር፣ የሥራ ዕድልና የሕዝብ አገልግሎት መሻሻል ጥያቄዎችን በፖለቲካው መስክ ለማስፈጸም እየተንቀሳቀሱ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ አብዛኛው ወጣት አሁንም በምርጫ ሂደት ውስጥ ተሳትፎው አነስተኛ ሆኖ መቀጠሉ ትልቅ ፈተና ሆኗል። ይህ ምርጫ ወጣቶች በተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ያሳዩትን ተነሳሽነት ወደ ህግ አውጪ አካል መቀየር መቻላቸውን የሚወስን ይሆናል።
oromo: Maaratookii keessatti dargaggoonniifi aktivistoonni gaaffiiwwan jijjiiramaa, kanneen akka tajaajila hawaasaa fooyyessuu fi hojii dhabdummaa hir'isuu gara paarlaamaatti ceesisuuf dorgomaa jiru. Dargaggoonni kun duula mormii waggaa darbe gaggeessan booda, jijjiirama siyaasaa bu'uuraa fiduuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru. Haa ta'u malee, hirmaannaan dargaggootaa qooda fudhannaa sagalee kennuu irratti xiqqaa ta'uun isaa qormaata guddaa ta'ee jira; kunis filannoon kun jijjiirama siyaasaa bu'uuraa fiduu fi dhiisuu isaa kan mirkaneessu ta'a.

title: How thousands of migrants stranded in Ceuta are surviving
english: In late July, a sudden influx of 72,000 migrants crossed from Morocco into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta within just two days. This massive surge has overwhelmed local services, leaving at least 10,000 people stranded in the territory. The situation has triggered a significant humanitarian crisis as local authorities struggle to provide for the large number of individuals now trapped in the area.
amharic: በሐምሌ ወር መጨረሻ ላይ በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ 72,000 የሚጠጉ ስደተኞች ከሞሮኮ ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ ተሻግረዋል። ይህ ከፍተኛ የሰው ቁጥር አካባቢውን በመጨናነቁ ቢያንስ 10,000 የሚሆኑ ስደተኞች እዚያው እንዲጣበቁ አድርጓል። የአካባቢው አስተዳደር የተፈጠረውን ከፍተኛ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ለመቋቋም እየተቸገረ ይገኛል።
oromo: dhuma ji'a July keessa godaantonnii 72,000 ta'an gabaabduu keessatti Morookoo irraa gara daangaa Ispeen kan taate Se'uutaatti ce'anii turan. Lakkoofsi namaa hedduun kun daangicha waan cufameef, godaantonnii 10,000 ol ta'an achitti haala rakkisaa keessatti argamu. Rakkoon kun balaa namoomaa guddaa uumuun, mootummaan naannichaa namoota kana gargaaruuf gidiramaa jira.

title: Former ‘death squad’ leader appears in military trial in The Gambia
english: Sanna Manjang, the former leader of a notorious Gambian paramilitary group, is facing a military court trial for deserting the army in 2017. He fled the country following the end of President Yahya Jammeh's long-term rule, during which his unit was linked to numerous human rights abuses. While previous murder charges against him were dropped, this military trial represents a new effort by the Gambian government to hold former officials accountable for their actions.
amharic: የጋምቢያው የፓራሚሊታሪ ቡድን የቀድሞ መሪ ሳና ማንጃንግ በ2017 ከጦር ኃይሉ በመሰወራቸው በወታደራዊ ፍርድ ቤት ቀርበዋል። ማንጃንግ የተከሰሱት የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ያህያ ጃሜህ ከስልጣን ከተወገዱ በኋላ ሀገሪቱን ለቀው በመውጣታቸው ነው። ቀደም ሲል በነበሩባቸው የግድያ ወንጀሎች ክሱ ቢቋረጥም፣ አዲሱ የወታደራዊ ፍርድ ቤት ሂደት የቀድሞ ባለስልጣናትን ለፈጸሙት ጥፋት ተጠያቂ ለማድረግ የሚደረግ ጥረት አካል ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan duraanii garee hidhattoota Gambiyaa Saannaa Maanjaang, bara 2017 waraana gadi lakkisee baqachuun isaa himatamee mana murtiitti dhiyaate. Inni kan baqate pirezidantii duraanii Yaahyaa Jaameeh aangoo irraa kaafamanii booda yoo ta'u, gareen isaa kun dararaa mirga namoomaa hedduu raawwachuun himatama ture. Himannaan ajjeechaa dura isa irratti dhiyaatee ture kan hafe yoo ta'u, dhaddachi kun hooggantoota kanaan duraa itti gaafatamoo taasisuuf carraaqqii mootummaan godhuudha.

title: Trump speech inaudible as US networks boycott White House event
english: Major American television networks boycotted a White House event held to unveil a new helicopter pad. The protest was sparked by the administration's decision to ban CNN from the premises. Consequently, the president's speech could not be heard because it was drowned out by the noise of a helicopter throughout the event.
amharic: ዋና ዋና የአሜሪካ የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያዎች በኋይት ሀውስ ለሄሊኮፕተር ማረፊያ በተዘጋጀው የመክፈቻ ስነ-ስርዓት ላይ ተቃውሞ በማሰማት ዝግጅቱን ዘግበውታል። ተቃውሞው የተነሳው የኋይት ሀውስ አስተዳደር ሲኤንኤን (CNN) የተባለውን የዜና አውታር ግቢ እንዳይገባ በመከልከሉ ነው። በዚህም ምክንያት የፕሬዚዳንቱ ንግግር በሄሊኮፕተር ድምፅ በመሸፈኑ ምክንያት ሊሰማ አልቻለም።
oromo: Buufata xiyyara heelikoptaraa haaraa kan Mana Caffee (White House) eebbisuuf qophiin ta'e kun, midiyaalee gurguddoo Ameerikaatiin hiriira mormii irratti godhameen osoo hin gabaafamin hafe. Mormiin kun kan uumame, bulchiinsi Mana Caffee kun dhaabbata oduu CNN jedhamu naannicha akka hin seenne dhorkachuu isaatiin walqabatee dha. Haaluma kanaan, yeroo pirezidaantiin kun dubbatan sagaleen heelikoptarichaa dubbii isaanii waan haguugeef, namni dubbii isaanii dhaga'uu hin dandeenye.

title: Putin’s party wins supermajority in Russia’s parliamentary election
english: President Vladimir Putin’s United Russia party secured a significant supermajority in the recent Russian parliamentary elections. The voting process effectively sidelined real opposition candidates, and the results include ballots from illegally annexed Ukrainian territories. This outcome reinforces Putin's political control and indicates strong government backing for the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.
amharic: የፕሬዚዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን የተባበረችው ሩሲያ ፓርቲ በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የሩሲያ የፓርላማ ምርጫ ከፍተኛ ድል አስመዝግቧል። የምርጫ ሂደቱ ትክክለኛ የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎችን ያገለለ ሲሆን ውጤቱም በሩሲያ ከተያዙ የዩክሬን ግዛቶች የተሰጡ ድምፆችን ያካተተ ነው። ይህ ውጤት የፑቲንን የፖለቲካ ቁጥጥር ከማጠናከሩም በላይ በዩክሬን ለሚካሄደው ጦርነት መንግስት ጠንካራ ድጋፍ እንዳለው ያሳያል።
oromo: Paartiin Preezdaant Vladimir Puutin 'United Russia' jedhamu filannoo paarlaamaa Raashiyaatti injifannoo guddaa gonfateera. Adeemsi filannoo kun mormitoota dhugaa kan hin hirmaachisne yoo ta'u, bu'aan isaas naannolee Yuukireen Raashiyaan humnaan qabatte irraa sagalee argame dabalata. Injifannoon kun aangoo siyaasaa Puutin cimsuu fi waraana Yuukireen keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiruuf mootummaan deggersa qabaachuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: UN Chief Guterres calls for ban on ‘killer robots’
english: United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres has formally requested a global ban on autonomous weapons, often referred to as killer robots. He argues that artificial intelligence should never be granted the authority to make critical life-or-death decisions on the battlefield. Guterres emphasized the urgent need to prevent machines from being used for lethal military operations.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ፀሃፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝ በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት የሚሰሩ እና ገዳይ የሆኑ ሮቦቶችን በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ለመከልከል ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ማሽኖች የሰውን ህይወት የመቅጠፍ ውሳኔዎችን እንዲወስኑ መፍቀድ እንደሌለበት አሳስበዋል። ጉቴሬዝ እነዚህ ቴክኖሎጂዎች በጦርነት ውስጥ ገዳይ እርምጃዎችን እንዳይወስዱ በጥብቅ መቆጣጠር እንደሚያስፈልግ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomani Antonio Guterres, robootonni ofiin of hoogganan fi lubbuu balleessuu danda'an addunyaa irraa akka dhorgaman gaafataniiru. Innis, ogummaan nama tolche (AI) murtee lubbuu namaa irratti hundaa'e dabarsuu akka hin qabne ibseera. Guterres teeknolojiiwwan kunniin waraana keessatti lubbuu galaafachuuf akka hin oolle tarkaanfii fudhachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu hubachiisaniiru.

title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
english: Escalating conflict between Houthi rebels and Saudi-backed forces in Yemen has forced over 120,000 people to flee their homes. Many refugees are making dangerous journeys across the Red Sea by boat to reach safety in neighboring Djibouti. Families arrive at displacement camps exhausted and with few belongings, driven by the trauma of constant aerial bombardments and fighting.
amharic: በየመን በሁቲ አማፂያን እና በሳውዲ በሚደገፉ ሃይሎች መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት ከ120,000 በላይ ሰዎችን ከመኖሪያቸው እንዲሰደዱ አድርጓል። ብዙ ስደተኞች ቀይ ባህርን በጀልባ በማቋረጥ ወደ ጅቡቲ ለመድረስ አደገኛ ጉዞ እያደረጉ ነው። ቤተሰቦች በአየር ጥቃት እና በጦርነት ፍርሃት ተገደው አገራቸውን በመልቀቅ በስደተኞች መጠለያ ካምፖች ውስጥ በከፍተኛ ችግር ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Yemen keessatti waraanni Houthisii fi humnoota Sa’udii deggaramanii jidduutti cimaa deemuun namoota kuma dhibba tokko fi kuma digdama ol ta’an godaansisuu isaa ibsameera. Baqattoonni hedduun lubbuu isaanii oolchuuf galaana Diimaa markabaan qaxxaamuruun gara Jibuutii godaanaa jiru. Miidhaa waraanaa fi dhukaasa xiyyaaraa irraa baqachuudhaan, maatiin baqattootaa kun qabeenya isaanii malee kaampiiwwan baqattootaa keessatti haala ulfaataa keessa jiru.

title: First UK charges brought over 1994 Rwanda genocide
english: A 65-year-old Rwandan man living in London has become the first person charged in the UK in connection with the 1994 Rwandan genocide. Dr. Vincent Brown is accused of inciting and directing acts of murder and genocide following a lengthy seven-year police investigation. This case serves as a warning that the UK will hold individuals accountable for international crimes rather than serving as a refuge for them.
amharic: በለንደን የሚኖር የ65 ዓመት የሩዋንዳዊ ተወላጅ በ1994 በሩዋንዳ በተፈጸመው የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ተሳትፈዋል ተብለው በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ክስ የተመሰረተባቸው የመጀመሪያው ሰው ሆነዋል። ዶክተር ቪንሰንት ብራውን የሰባት ዓመት ምርመራ ከተደረገ በኋላ የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀልን በማቀነባበር እና በመምራት ተከስሰዋል። ይህ ክስ ብሪታኒያ ለዓለም አቀፍ ወንጀለኞች መሸሸጊያ እንደማትሆን እና ተጠያቂነትን ለማስፈን ቁርጠኛ መሆኗን ያሳያል።
oromo: Namni lammii Ruwaandaa waggaa 65 kan London jiraatu tokko, bara 1994 Ruwaandaatti saba-fixiinsa geggeeffame waliin walqabatee biyya UK keessatti kan himatame nama jalqabaa ta'eera. Doktar Viinsent Biraawun qorannoo waggaa torba fudhateen booda, ajjeechaa fi saba-fixiinsa geggeessuu fi kakaasuun himatameera. Himannaan kunis UK bakka namoonni yakka akkanaa raawwatan itti dhokatan akka hin taane fi seeraan akka itti gaafataman akeekkachiisa.

title: Millions urged to evacuate as powerful Typhoon Dujuan hits Japan
english: Powerful Typhoon Dujuan has struck Japan, forcing authorities to issue evacuation orders for nearly two million residents due to severe weather risks. The storm caused widespread power outages, transportation cancellations, and the suspension of various public events during a major holiday. While some weather warnings have been downgraded, officials remain concerned about landslide threats and have urged the public to stay cautious.
amharic: ኃይለኛው የዱጁዋን አውሎ ንፋስ ጃፓንን በመምታቱ፣ ባለስልጣናት በአደጋው ስጋት ምክንያት ለሁለት ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ነዋሪዎች የለቀቃ ትእዛዝ አስተላልፈዋል። አውሎ ንፋሱ በበዓል ወቅት በብዙ አካባቢዎች የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ፣ የበረራ ስረዛ እና የተለያዩ ዝግጅቶች እንዲቋረጡ አድርጓል። ምንም እንኳን አንዳንድ የአየር ንብረት ማስጠንቀቂያዎች ቢቀነሱም፣ መንግስት የመሬት መንሸራተት ስጋት ስላለ ህዝቡ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርግ አሳስቧል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin Dujuan jedhamu biyya Jaappaan rukutuun, balaa cimaa akkasumas akka namoonni miliyoona lama ta'an bakka isaanii gadhiisan dirqisiiseera. Obomboleettiin kun yeroo boqonnaa ummataa keessa waan dhufeef, tajaajilli elektirikii fi geejjibaa addaan citee, akkasumas sagantaaleen garaagaraa akka haqaman ta'eera. Gorsi haala qilleensaa tokko tokko yoo xiqqatayyuu, mootummaan balaa lafa sigigoo fi miidhaa biroo irraa akka of eeggatan ummata gorseera.

title: Protesters blockade Elbit Systems factory over Israel weapons supply
english: A group called 'Silence Elbit Drones' organized a protest at a factory in Staffordshire, UK, to block access to the site. The nine activists chained themselves to equipment to disrupt the company's daily operations. They are demonstrating against Elbit Systems for providing military technology to Israel.
amharic: በእንግሊዝ ስታፎርድሻየር የሚገኝ የኤልቢት ሲስተምስ ፋብሪካ በዘጠኝ ተቃዋሚዎች ታገደ። 'ሳይለንስ ኤልቢት ድሮንስ' የተሰኘው ቡድን አባላት ፋብሪካው ለእስራኤል የጦር መሳሪያዎችን በማቅረቡ ተቃውሟቸውን ለመግለጽ በአካባቢው ተሰባስበዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የኩባንያውን የስራ እንቅስቃሴ ለማስተጓጎል ሲባል እራሳቸውን በመሳሪያዎች በመቆለፍ የፋብሪካውን መግቢያ ዘግተው ነበር።
oromo: Hiriirtonni sagalee 'Silence Elbit Drones' jedhamuun beekaman, qindoomina isaanii kanaan magaala Staafordshaayer keessatti warshaa Elbit Systems jedhamu cufanii jiru. Namoonni sagal ta'an kun, warshichi Israa'elitti meeshaa waraanaa dhiyeessuu isaa mormuuf jecha karaa seenu cufaniiru. Gocha kanaanis hojiin warshichaa akka dhaabatuuf ofitti hidhuun hiriira isaanii gaggeessaniiru.

title: Trump’s approval rating hits record low amid Iran war, economy fallout
english: President Donald Trump's approval rating has dropped to a career-low of 32 percent, primarily due to public frustration over high living costs and the ongoing war with Iran. Support from his own Republican base has significantly declined, with voters expressing deep concern about fuel prices ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. While the President recently signaled hope for an end to the conflict, the administration faces significant political challenges as economic issues continue to dominate voter sentiment.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሕዝብ ድጋፍ በኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ እና በአትራን ጦርነት ምክንያት ወደ 32 በመቶ ዝቅ ብሏል፤ ይህም በፖለቲካ ሕይወታቸው ከተመዘገቡት ዝቅተኛው ነው። የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ደጋፊዎች በኑሮ ውድነት እና በነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪ ላይ ያላቸው ቅሬታ እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ በምርጫው ላይ ተጽዕኖ ይኖረዋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። ምንም እንኳን ትራምፕ የጦርነቱ ፍጻሜ እንደቀረበ ቢጠቁሙም፣ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ችግሮች በአገሪቱ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ላይ ተግዳሮት ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Hirmaannaan amantii fi degarsi Pirezidaant Doolaard Traamp irraa qaban gara dhibbeentaa 32tti gadi bu'eera; kunis kan ta'e baasii jireenyaa olka'aa fi waraana Iraan waliin taasifamuun walqabatee dha. Deeggarsii miseensota paartii Ripaabilikaanii keessaatti qabanis hir'achaa kan dhufe yoo ta'u, lammiileen gatiin boba'aa dabaluu isaatti gaddanii jiru. Traamp waraanni kun xumura irra akka gahe dubbatanii jiranillee, rakkoon dinagdee filannoo dhufu irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumee jira.

title: Photos: Gaza’s children return to class in tents and ruins
english: Hundreds of thousands of students in Gaza have resumed their education for the first time in three years, despite the vast majority of school buildings being destroyed or severely damaged. Classes are now being held in makeshift tents and temporary structures due to the ongoing conflict and extreme shortages of basic supplies like stationery. Despite the loss of many teachers and students, children are returning to these difficult environments with a determination to continue their learning.

These demonstrations are occurring alongside separate political tensions involving demands for the release of Imran Khan.

english: A political controversy has emerged in Spanish football after Real Madrid players wore solidarity shirts regarding the migrant crisis in the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. The move sparked backlash and debate because some fans and officials felt it took sides in the ongoing tensions between Spain and Morocco. While some players intended to show support for both the region and the suffering migrants, others, including La Liga leadership, criticized the players for involving sport in a complex political conflict.

title: US Treasury chief says Iran airlines to be 'shut down' 23 September
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that Iranian airlines will be effectively grounded globally starting September 23 due to new, severe American sanctions. International entities are now prohibited from offering fuel, landing services, or ticket sales to these airlines under threat of being expelled from the US dollar financial system. This action is part of the Trump administration's broader strategy to intensify economic pressure on Tehran.

title: In defence of Israel's Jewish settlers in the West Bank
english: Several Western nations, including the UK, France, and Canada, have recently implemented trade bans on products from Jewish settlements in the West Bank due to rising settler violence and long-standing international legal concerns. While Israel has retaliated with diplomatic restrictions against British officials, critics argue these boycotts are inconsistent because they do not cover all Israeli-controlled territories. The article highlights that these settlements have been considered illegal under international law for decades, raising questions about why these specific actions are being taken now.

title: Tunisia arrests at least 11 pro-Palestine protesters
english: Tunisian authorities have detained at least 11 individuals following a protest held to demand the release of other pro-Palestinian activists. While lawyers and local groups provided varying estimates on the number of people arrested, officials have yet to confirm an exact count. A judge has ordered a 48-hour extension for the detention of those currently in custody.

title: Merz vows to keep coalition together for Germany's 'democratic future'
english: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has pledged to maintain his governing coalition despite suffering significant losses in recent state elections. While his party faces pressure due to rising support for the far-right Alternative for Germany party, Merz insists that staying in office is vital for the nation's democratic stability.
